explication: macai is a native macOS AI chat client. Users configure an API service and persona, compose a message (optionally with attachments), send it through the chat workflow to an AI provider, and view the response in the conversation. Chats and settings are persisted locally, with optional iCloud sync; preferences also expose service, persona, backup/restore, and general settings. The source index supports the central UI, message, persistence, and attachment relationships below; some capability links are documented in the README, while unsampled implementation details are left unconnected.
